The '''1976–77 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]].

==Teams==
[[Genoa CFC|Genoa]], [[Catanzaro Calcio|Catanzaro]] and [[US Foggia|Foggia]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
